items.text: So glad to have been on hand for this morning’s announcement from @Norton_Health & @GoodwillKY. West Louisville deserves the very best and that’s precisely what these two partner organizations bring to the table. Thrilled to see this $100M investment in health & economic equity. https://t.co/nsSzhP9M3k

$1,000,000 to @bellarmineU's efforts to build a community health professional simulation center, providing students with the necessary equipment and experiential learning opportunities to engage in patient care in a real-world health care environment.

This expansion will help improve care, expand access, and further grow our city’s health care workforce. Glad to see that state-of-the-art, patient-centered care will be the hallmark of UofL Hospital for years to come. https://t.co/HgfZKZMFrp

I’m testifying before @NRDems this AM on my bill to stop the approval of Mountaintop Removal Mining permits until a federally-funded health study is complete. People in coal country deserve answers on what effect this reckless practice has on their health. https://t.co/sVOxd2m8M6

Coal companies have ravaged our mountaintops for more than 50yrs without a single federal study of the health effects on surrounding communities. Proud to testify at @NRDems today to call for a halt to all new MTR mining permits until a study is done. KY families deserve answers. https://t.co/XiKJwZ12hb

This legislation Congress just sent to President Biden for his signature, which I was proud to support, will help save lives by keeping weapons out of dangerous hands, strengthening mental health services, and improving school safety.

Our city & nation have lost a giant in the fight for health equity. Dr. Adewale Troutman was a force for good—a leader of @LouMetroHealth, @PublicHealth, & more—who devoted his entire life & career to caring for others. My thoughts are with Denise and the entire Troutman family. https://t.co/jurFs5cmle

This morning, I tested positive for COVID. Thankfully, I am fully vaccinated, double-boosted, and am experiencing no symptoms other than a light cough. I’ll continue to follow CDC guidelines and will be working from home for the remainder of this week. Stay safe, everyone!

The #InflationReductionAct is an enormous win for American families and for the future of our planet.

I'm honored to be the lead sponsor of this historic bill that will lower the cost of prescription drugs and health care while investing in cleaner, cheaper energy.

The historic #InflationReductionAct will save families money on prescription drugs and health care, while making the largest-ever investment to tackle the climate crisis.

I'm honored to be bringing it to the floor today—and ready for @HouseDemocrats to send it to @POTUS's desk. https://t.co/y1NHH4bSam

So glad to be back on @bellarmineU's campus and proud to have secured $1 million in funding for their Community Health Professions Simulation Training Center. This center will provide hands-on training to ensure that our city is home to the health care workforce of tomorrow. https://t.co/U1c7DiWmC5
I appreciate Lindsey’s honesty here. Congressional Republicans are now openly promoting their plan to make basic health care illegal and imprison women and doctors.
Shana Tova to all who join me in celebrating Rosh Hashanah. From my family to yours, may the new year bring you health and happiness. https://t.co/sgUEgewLsd

Wishing all observing Yom Kippur here in Louisville and around the globe an easy and meaningful fast. May the new year bring you and your family good health and blessings. G’mar Chatima Tova. https://t.co/V7eX4rmWVl

Wishing everyone a safe and happy Thanksgiving today. I’m thankful to have my loving family, good health, and the opportunity to serve as Louisville’s Congressman for the past 16 years. It’s been an honor.

I joined @CapehartJ on @TheSundayShow today to discuss the importance of reaching an agreement to fund the government & raise the debt ceiling.

Republicans’ willingness to use the debt ceiling as a legislative nuclear weapon to cut Social Security & Medicare is unconscionable. https://t.co/QOIPGzbK8d

This bill includes more than $18 million I secured to fund 15 critical projects across Louisville — from protecting children and our most vulnerable communities to expanding health care access, improving our roads and sewers, and finally taking on the 9th street divide.

Thirteen years ago today President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law. Tens of millions of Americans now have quality healthcare as a result. It was one of the proudest moments of my 16 years in Congress.

My thanks to the LMPD officers who responded so bravely, as well as other first responders and our medical community. My deepest sympathies to the families of the victims. My eternal condemnation of the cowardly politicians who refuse to act to stop gun violence in our country.

16 years ago as a freshman congressman, I voted to allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices to lower costs for seniors. Today, thanks to Biden and congressional Dems, that process finally begins. Sometimes the smart and rich thing takes a a long time.
After watching coverage of the Trump trial on MSNBC and FOX, I have only one thing to say: It’s a national scandal that this trial is not being televised.
More than 30 seconds. Where is national media coverage?

So much to say about Harris’s thumping of Trump, but his ignorance about healthcare was pathetic. He said, “IF” there is a way to get better care for less money, he’d propose it. Duh! Wouldn’t we all do that? He had 4 years to find one but never even came up with a “concept.”

Think about it. Congressional Republicans meet at 1 am to move a bill that will not only cut 13.7 million Americans off Medicaid, but now we learn also cuts $500 BILLION from Medicare. Shameful and dangerous.

This resignation letter should alarm every American, especially anyone responsible for the health and welfare of our children. No one should trust health advice coming from our government until HHS Secretary Kennedy is gone and replaced by someone with respect for science.
